description_en: Queries the regions where assets are located
name: ListRegions

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter regions by assets with auditing enabled. Valid values: true: Enabled. false: Disabled. If you do not specify this parameter, this filter condition is not applied
parameters.help_zh: 是否按已开启审计的资产筛选地域。true 表示已开启，false 表示未开启；不传则不使用此条件
parameters.name: audited

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter regions by assets with detection enabled. Valid values: true: Enabled. false: Disabled. If you do not specify this parameter, this filter condition is not applied
parameters.help_zh: 是否按已开启识别的资产筛选地域。true 表示已开启，false 表示未开启；不传则不使用此条件
parameters.name: identified

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retrieve all regions
parameters.name: load_all

RegionList.description_en: The list of regions where the assets are located

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the assets are located

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the assets are located

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
